253:t_1:4.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...Well then, everyone who's gathered here...」

253:t_1:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Combining the information the $$ゲッター$$ Team received from $$グーラ$$, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s knowledge, and a cross-check against the galactic star charts...」

253:t_1:8.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Putting all of that together, we have arrived at a startling conclusion about our current position.」

253:t_1:9.en:
$$アキラ$$
「Skip the preamble and hurry up already.」

253:t_1:10.en:
$$木下$$
「We're so eager to know that we can't sit still a moment longer.」

253:t_1:11.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Very well, I'll announce it...!」

253:t_1:12.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Astonishingly... it has been determined that our current position is near the center of the Milky Way!」

253:t_1:14.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The $$マクロス・クォーター$$ and the $$ラー・カイラム$$, which we were separated from in subspace, are probably in a similar situation.」

253:t_1:15.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Though they are probably several light-years away from us.」

253:t_1:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「The center of the galaxy... About 27,000 light-years from Earth, then...」

253:t_1:18.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Did you know about this, $$ノリコ$$?」

253:t_1:19.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah... It was in my own world, but I've fought at the galactic center before.」

253:t_1:20.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Impressive, $$ノリコ$$. If possible, I'd love to hear that story... at leisure.」

253:t_1:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, Big Bro $$ニコラ$$... Don't interrupt the discussion by hitting on people.」

253:t_1:22.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Sorry, sorry, $$勝平$$. ...Well then, $$ノリコ$$... let's save this talk for later.」

253:t_1:25.en:
$$チコ$$
「You're in a bad mood, Princess.」

253:t_1:27.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Um, everyone... Aren't you going to be a little more... surprised?」

253:t_1:28.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Don't look at us like that. We kind of figured this wasn't the solar system anyway.」

253:t_1:29.en:
$$赤木$$
「Once you're this far from Earth, it doesn't even feel real.」

253:t_1:30.en:
$$青山$$
「The question is whether we can get back to Earth.」

253:t_1:31.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We have an answer to that as well. We can.」

253:t_1:34.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Please wait a moment! I did say we can return, but even by a conservative estimate, it will be a journey of about ten years!」

253:t_1:37.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The distance the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ can advance with a hyperspace jump isn't all that great, you see.」

253:t_1:38.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We jump, survey the surrounding conditions, and once the energy has built up, jump again... All we can do is repeat that.」

253:t_1:39.en:
$$渓$$
「So we jumped that whole distance in an instant to get here...」

253:t_1:40.en:
$$凱$$
「The power of the $$ゲッター線$$ is something else, huh...」

253:t_1:41.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$'s transfer was certainly due to the power of the $$ゲッター線$$, but our case is somewhat different.」

253:t_1:42.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We were caught up in the $$時空震動$$ at $$第２新東京市$$, and it is presumed that its power threw us all the way to the galactic center.」

253:t_1:43.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Though it was probably the influence of the $$ゲッター線$$ that made us warp out into this region of space.」

253:t_1:45.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Who knows... I'm no $$ゲッター$$ Ray myself, so I couldn't say.」

253:t_1:46.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch... I thought with $$ゲッター$$'s power we could get home in an instant, but it doesn't work like that, huh.」

253:t_1:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Aw, man... In ten years, I won't be an elementary school president anymore.」

253:t_1:48.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's too bad. I wanted to graduate from elementary school with $$マッキー$$ and everyone.」

253:t_1:49.en:
$$柿小路$$
「We'll have to live long, Managing Director.」

253:t_1:50.en:
$$厚井$$
「Indeed, Executive Director. Let's both take care of our health.」

253:t_1:51.en:
$$ランド$$
「First priority is securing food and water. If it's going to be a long trip, we have to do something about that.」

253:t_1:52.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「I hear the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ has at least two months' worth of supplies stockpiled.」

253:t_1:53.en:
$$メール$$
「Then we have to figure something out within those two months.」

253:t_1:54.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Um, everyone... You don't seem very shocked by this fact either...」

253:t_1:55.en:
$$ランド$$
「Who's got time for that? We decided we're going home no matter what.」

253:t_1:56.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've been ready for this ever since we got thrown out here. No way I'm getting down about it now.」

253:t_1:57.en:
$n
「All that's left is to think about how much we can shorten the trip.」

253:t_1:59.en:
$$葵$$
「Too bad, $$田中$$. Did you want to see us despair?」

253:t_1:60.en:
$$シモン$$
「Sorry, but we left the whole emotion of despair behind somewhere along the way.」

253:t_1:61.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Goodness... everyone's positivity far exceeded the expectations of both myself and $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$.」

253:t_1:62.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Of course, I am a member of $c as well. If you had all been discouraged, I intended to give you a slap on the rear to get you moving.」

253:t_1:63.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Thank goodness... If I'd despaired, I'd have been touched by $$田中$$!」

253:t_1:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's abuse of authority and sexual harassment!」

253:t_1:65.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Ha ha... It seems I counted my chickens before they hatched.」

253:t_1:66.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$田中$$, you and the others think of a way to get home even a little sooner.」

253:t_1:67.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We'll take care of anyone who gets in the way of that.」

253:t_1:68.en:
$$隼人$$
「Judging by how today went, the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s will probably show up again too.」

253:t_1:70.en:
$$赤木$$
「Come to think of it, those guys...! Why are they in a place like this!?」

253:t_1:71.en:
$$甲児$$
「I heard from $$レド$$ that the $$サイデリアル$$ are also fighting the $$人類銀河同盟$$ at the galactic center.」

253:t_1:72.en:
$$甲児$$
「According to him, their main force stays at the center of the galaxy, and being out on a frontier like Earth is the rare case.」

253:t_1:73.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Then it's abnormal that $$アウストラリス$$, the ruler of the $$サイデリアル$$, is on Earth too.」

253:t_1:74.en:
$$ランド$$
「They're after $$地球の次元力$$. Which means Earth is worth that much.」

253:t_1:75.en:
$n
「And they're collecting $$スフィア・リアクター$$s to use $$地球の次元力$$ in their fight against the $$人類銀河同盟$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s...」

253:t_1:76.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then maybe the $$サイデリアル$$ guys have tech that gets them to Earth a lot more easily?」

253:t_1:77.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Look at you being sharp for once, $$赤木$$!」

253:t_1:78.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Which means if we fight them...」

253:t_1:79.en:
$$恵子$$
「Then maybe we can get back to Earth even sooner!」

253:t_1:80.en:
$$勝平$$
「Now that's what I like! Come on, come on, $$サイデリアル$$-chan!」

uncertain: 253:t_1:62/63/64: 尻を叩く rendered 'slap on the rear to get you moving' so Yoko's タッチ ('touched by Tanaka') and Suzune's セクハラ joke lands; idiom meaning is 'spur on'
253:t_1:45: ゲッター線ならぬ rendered as wordplay 'I'm no Getter Ray myself'
253:t_1:80: サイデリアルちゃん kept as 'Sidereal-chan' (mocking cute address), alternative would be 'my little Sidereal pals'
253:t_1:14: 亜空間 = 'subspace', 253:t_1:37 超空間ジャンプ = 'hyperspace jump' (matches 628:t_10:4 note); no earlier row for 亜空間
253:t_1:48: speaker is 正太郎 (Shotaro) while 'we graduate elementary school with Makki' - followed speaker line as given
253:t_1:49/50: Kakikouji 専務 = Executive Director, Atsui 常務 = Managing Director (settled company titles)
253:t_1:7: ＷＩＬＬさん rendered with token only (gender n/a, no honorific); グーラ君 = token only
253:t_1:12: 銀河系 = 'the Milky Way' once, 銀河 elsewhere = 'galaxy'
253:t_1:74/75: 地球の次元力 uses the proposed keyword token $$地球の次元力$$ (no 《》 in the Japanese)
